## Work order (draft)

- **Title:** Suspected A feed loss (stream 1, IDV(6)), C header pressure loss (stream 4, IDV(7)) and A/B/C feed composition variation (stream 4, IDV(8))
- **Priority:** High (gate status VERIFIED)
- **Suspected causes (approved, in order):** IDV(6), IDV(7), IDV(8)
- **Evidence (verified only):**
  - XMEAS(1) — down
  - XMV(3) — up
  - XMEAS(20) — down
  - XMEAS(29) — down
- **Requested inspection** (from *inspection_guide_by_disturbance.md*, "Inspection guide by disturbance IDV(1)–IDV(15)"; entries cross-referenced with *tep_process_description.md*):
  - **IDV(6) — component A feed loss (stream 1), step:**
    - Check the stream 1 supply: upstream isolation valves, header pressure, and supplier status.
    - Inspect the stream 1 flow transmitter and the feed valve.
    - Verify the stream 1 line for blockage or leakage.
  - **IDV(7) — component C header pressure loss (stream 4), step:**
    - Measure the C header pressure at the field gauge.
    - Check the supply source and the pressure regulator on the C header.
    - Inspect the stream 4 feed valve and the flow transmitter.
  - **IDV(8) — A, B, C feed composition variation (stream 4), random variation:**
    - Sample the stream 4 feed over time and verify the composition variability.
    - Check the feed analyzer and the upstream mixing or blending point.
    - Verify the stream 4 flow transmitter for noise.

## Shift handover

The alarm (sample index 173) started at a time that is not provided in the approved diagnosis. The approved diagnosis lists IDV(6) component A feed loss (stream 1), IDV(7) component C header pressure loss (stream 4), and IDV(8) A/B/C feed composition variation (stream 4). Confidence is high: the evidence gate is VERIFIED with full agreement between samples (1.00), supported by the verified evidence XMEAS(1) down, XMV(3) up, XMEAS(20) down and XMEAS(29) down. Evidence rejected by the gate is not provided in the approved diagnosis. Pending: the maintenance inspections requested in the work order to confirm or rule out each of the three causes.

## Work order (draft)

- **Title:** Suspected component C header pressure loss on stream 4 (IDV(7)), with IDV(8) and IDV(1) also approved as candidate causes.
- **Priority:** Medium (gate status: PARTIAL).
- **Suspected causes (approved, in order):** IDV(7), IDV(8), IDV(1)
- **Evidence (verified only):**
  - XMEAS(23) (down)
  - XMEAS(25) (up)
  - XMEAS(29) (down)
  - XMEAS(31) (up)
- **Requested inspection** (per *inspection_guide_by_disturbance.md*, "Inspection guide by disturbance IDV(1)-IDV(15)"; cause names from *tep_process_description.md*):
  - **IDV(7) — component C header pressure loss, reduced availability (stream 4):** Measure the C header pressure at the field gauge; check the supply source and the pressure regulator on the C header; inspect the stream 4 feed valve and the flow transmitter.
  - **IDV(8) — component A, B, C feed composition variation (stream 4):** Sample the stream 4 feed over time and verify the composition variability; check the feed analyzer and the upstream mixing or blending point; verify the stream 4 flow transmitter for noise.
  - **IDV(1) — A/C feed ratio change in stream 4 (B composition constant):** Check the stream 4 flow measurement and its transmitter calibration; sample the stream 4 feed and verify the A/C ratio against the analyzer reading; inspect the stream 4 feed control valve and the upstream supply of A and C.

## Shift handover

Alarm sample index 173 is on file; the start time of the alarm is not provided. The operator has approved a diagnosis of component C header pressure loss on stream 4 (IDV(7)), with A/B/C feed composition variation on stream 4 (IDV(8)) and an A/C feed ratio change on stream 4 (IDV(1)) as additional approved candidate causes. Sample agreement is 1.00, but the deterministic gate returned a PARTIAL status, so the diagnosis is to be treated as moderately confident. The gate rejected XMEAS(1) (up) as evidence; it must not be used as support. Pending: maintenance inspection of the C header, stream 4 supply and analyzer checks as listed in the work order, after which findings are to be reported to the operator.
